instruction: Refocus the camera and ask the patient to blink to clear haze for sharper small vessels.
Refocus the camera and retake, ensuring the small central vessels appear sharp and clear.
Shift the view leftward so the central disc and the area to its left are both near the centre.
Re-aim more to the left to center the optic disc and macula together.
Hold upper eyelid up and clear lashes from top, then retake to remove upper shadow and central glare.
Hold upper and lower lids wide open to clear top and bottom shadows, clean lens to remove spots and retake.
Refocus on small vessels, clean lens, ask patient to open wide to clear central haze and right-side and top glare.
Refocus to sharpen small vessels, ask patient to open wide and lift upper lid to clear dark shadow top-center.
